propositions: Backfill close_class for already-closed bugs lacking it using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record → env_integration, otherwise → undetermined
Backfill records are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate them from authoritative close_class values
Script must skip bugs that already have close_class set or are already recorded in the backfill artifact, ensuring idempotency by ticket_id
Revert signals must target substantive event types (STATUS or COMMITS), not comment/link reverts, to qualify as regression evidence
Plan-review BLOCK signal must be read via rebar.llm.plan_review.sidecar.all_review_results, and gate_error_v1 signals must use raw event-file scanning to bypass schema guards

Four test cases validate: regression from STATUS revert, plan_defect from BLOCK, env_integration from gate_error, undetermined for plain closed bug, plus idempotence and authoritative-value protection
